description: This bar chart illustrates the scores achieved by three different models—SRPO-7B, GRPO-7B, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B—across four distinct tasks: MathVista, MathVerse, MMMU-Pro, and Physics. The horizontal axis displays the task names in the order MathVista, MathVerse, MMMU-Pro, and Physics, while the vertical axis represents the “Score” on a linear scale ranging from 35 to 80, with tick marks at intervals of 5.  Three bars are present for each task, representing the performance of each model; SRPO-7B is represented by a dark blue bar, GRPO-7B by a medium blue bar, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B by a light blue bar. For the MathVista task, SRPO-7B achieves a score of 75.8, GRPO-7B scores 72.3, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B scores 68.2. The shortest bars are for Qwen-2.5-VL-7B on the Physics task with a score of 45.4, and the tallest bar is for SRPO-7B on the MathVista task with a score of 75.8. The bars are grouped by task, with each model’s score displayed side-by-side for each task. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
